papers.title: Hydrogel-Based Bioinks for Three-Dimensional Bioprinting: Patent Analysis
papers.abstract: There are a variety of hydrogel-based bioinks commonly used in three-dimensional bioprinting. In this study, in the form of patent analysis, the state of the art has been reviewed by introducing what has been patented in relation to hydrogel-based bioinks. Furthermore, a detailed analysis of the patentability of the used hydrogels, their preparation methods and their formulations, as well as the 3D bioprinting process using hydrogels, have been provided by determining publication years, jurisdictions, inventors, applicants, owners, and classifications. The classification of patents reveals that most inventions intended for hydrogels used as materials for prostheses or for coating prostheses are characterized by their function or properties Knowledge clusters and expert driving factors show that biomaterials, tissue engineering, and biofabrication research is concentrated in the most patents.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是水凝胶基生物墨水的专利分析，未涉及人工智能在生物打印中的应用。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not integrate AI into any bioprinting workflow stage, lacks experimental validation, and is a patent review rather than a method development study.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述水凝胶基生物墨水的专利现状
summary_zh.method: 通过专利分析考察水凝胶制备方法、配方及3D生物打印过程
summary_zh.result: 发现大多数专利集中于用作假体或涂层的水凝胶材料
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，仅专利文献分析

summary_en.motivation: To review the state of the art in patented hydrogel-based bioinks for 3D bioprinting.
summary_en.method: Patent analysis was conducted on hydrogels, their preparation methods, formulations, and the bioprinting process.
summary_en.result: Most patents focus on hydrogels for prostheses or coating prostheses, with biomaterials, tissue engineering, and biofabrication being key clusters.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the study is a patent landscape analysis.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铜薄壁法兰的选区激光熔化工艺参数，与生物医用增材制造方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure design for stress shielding, no fatigue testing, no osseointegration or material compatibility evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化铜薄壁法兰的SLM工艺参数以提高质量。
summary_zh.method: 实验研究工艺参数和扫描路径对成形质量的影响。
summary_zh.result: 确定了最优参数组合，改善了致密度和表面质量。
summary_zh.validation: 通过密度测量和显微观察验证结果。

summary_en.motivation: Optimize selective laser melting process parameters for thin-walled copper flanges to improve part quality.
summary_en.method: Experimental investigation of the effects of process parameters and scanning patterns on density, surface roughness, and dimensional accuracy.
summary_en.result: Optimal process parameters were identified, leading to enhanced densification and surface finish.
summary_en.validation: Validation through density measurements, optical microscopy, and surface profilometry.

papers.title: Parametric Study of Selective Laser Melting Using Ti-6Al-4V Powder Bed for Concurrent Control of Volumetric Density and Surface Roughness
papers.venue: Journal of Korean Powder Metallurgy Institute

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选区激光熔化参数对Ti-6Al-4V合金密度和粗糙度的影响，主要关注工艺参数优化，未涉及生物医学植入物的力学性能或疲劳评估，但可为生物医学增材制造提供工艺背景。
llm.why_not_core: Does not link porous structure to stress shielding, lacks fatigue testing, no osseointegration or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化SLM参数以同时控制Ti-6Al-4V的密度和表面粗糙度
summary_zh.method: 改变激光功率、扫描速度等参数进行系统参数研究
summary_zh.result: 获得了可同时提高体积密度和降低表面粗糙度的工艺窗口
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量验证密度和粗糙度

summary_en.motivation: To optimize selective laser melting parameters for achieving high volumetric density and low surface roughness in Ti-6Al-4V parts.
summary_en.method: A parametric study varying laser power, scan speed, and other process parameters was conducted.
summary_en.result: Identified process windows that concurrently improve volumetric density and reduce surface roughness.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements of density and surface roughness were performed to validate the findings.
